## About
Import Connection is a used car dealer and repair shop in downtown Campbell, next to San Jose. We focus on Porsche, MINI Cooper, BMW and Mercedes-Benz, and our team can repair, upgrade and service your car.
The cars we sell are lease returns with low miles and clean titles. Each one goes through an extensive presale inspection and service before it goes on the lot. We also take trade-ins and offer extended warranty and financing.
Customers know us by the owner, Farhad, who reviewers mention by name. We're rated 4.5 from 38 Google reviews.

## Services
- Repair and scheduled maintenance: Diagnosis, repairs and routine maintenance, with a focus on Porsche, MINI Cooper, BMW and Mercedes-Benz.
- Used car dealer: Our lot is in downtown Campbell, next to San Jose.
- Trade-ins and extended warranty: Bring your current car in on trade, and ask about an extended warranty for your next one.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you specialize in?
A: Porsche, MINI Cooper, BMW and Mercedes-Benz.

Q: Can you upgrade my car, not just fix it?
A: Yes. Our team can repair, upgrade and service your vehicle.

Q: When are you open?
A: Tuesday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Sunday and Monday.
